xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4660: Duplicate-and-edit color theme editor in Settings > Appearance

plan.title: Duplicate-and-edit color theme editor in Settings > Appearance
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: PAN-4644 shipped color themes, but the only way to change a theme's colors is to hand-edit ~/.overdeck/themes/<id>.json. The store cannot overwrite a user theme (saveColorTheme always claims a new id), and the UI-token derivation writes straight to <html>, so there is no way to preview edits.
narratives.Proposal: Add updateColorTheme + PUT /api/color-themes/:id for in-place saves that refuse built-ins; extract uiTokenStyles from applyUiTokens; add a pure editor model (draft, duplicate naming, fixed seven-scope syntax editing, seeds); add an inline ColorThemeEditor with a ColorThemeEditorPreview (terminal sample, UI card, highlighted code) opened from a theme list in Settings > Appearance; duplicates save through POST /api/color-themes, user-theme edits through PUT, and both refresh via reconcileFromServer, which re-applies a selected theme without a reload. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-4660.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Editing signal or state colors (--state-*, --success*, --warning*, --destructive*, --info*, --signal-*)
- Editing arbitrary tokenColors rules, fontStyle, token backgrounds, or syntax.colors; only the foreground of the seven common scopes
- Editing terminal.cursorAccent or alpha channels
- Changing a theme's type (light/dark)
- Deleting or renaming theme files; changing a user theme's id
- Auto-selecting a newly saved duplicate
- Restamping the tmux window-style background of existing sessions
- Persisting an unsaved draft across a page reload
- A routed editor page or a modal editor
- .vsix import (#4659)
- Any change to packages/contracts/src/color-theme.ts

autoDecisions.summary: In-place save uses a new PUT /api/color-themes/:id route backed by updateColorTheme, not an id field on POST
autoDecisions.rationale: POST is create-only by design (claimThemeFile never overwrites); overwrite has distinct 403/404 failure modes, and the issue's POST wording describes saving a new theme.

autoDecisions.summary: The editor is an inline panel in the Appearance section, not a routed page or modal
autoDecisions.rationale: Matches the ColorThemeImportPreview inline precedent, the issue says the editor opens in Settings > Appearance, the 'pages not modals' rule targets modals, and it avoids touching app tab routing.

autoDecisions.summary: Edit all seven ui keys, including overlay
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's 'six keys' predates PAN-4755, which added ui.overlay to the contract and applyUiTokens.

autoDecisions.summary: Entry points are a theme list under the pickers with Duplicate and edit on every row and Edit on user-theme rows
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue says 'on any theme'; the pickers only show the selected theme.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixed scope strings: comment, string, keyword, entity.name.function, variable, constant.numeric, entity.name.type; edits update the last exact-scope entry or append one
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps every other token rule unchanged as the issue requires and gives one deterministic diff.

autoDecisions.summary: Not-set ui keys and syntax scopes show deterministic seeds from the effective terminal palette and are saved only when changed
autoDecisions.rationale: Built-ins carry no ui/syntax; writing seeds would silently change their look, and computed CSS values vary by design language and use non-hex formats.

autoDecisions.summary: Duplicate names: '<name> copy', then 'copy 2', 'copy 3', capped at 80 chars; duplicates drop source provenance; new copies are not auto-selected
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue specifies '<name> copy'; deduping keeps picker labels distinct; selection stays an explicit operator action.

autoDecisions.summary: Color pickers show toOpaqueHex values and write #rrggbb; untouched colors keep alpha

autoDecisions.rationale: PUT /api/color-themes/selection is a static route that shadows :id, so such a theme could never be edited in place.

items.title: Store: updateColorTheme overwrites a user theme in place

narrative.Action: Follow PRD W1 in .pan/drafts/PAN-4660.md exactly. In src/lib/color-themes/store.ts add the exported UpdateColorThemeResult union and async updateColorTheme(id, file): refuse built-in/reserved ids with kind 'builtin', reject ids failing COLOR_THEME_ID_RE with 'invalid-id', return 'not-found' when <themes>/<id>.json does not exist (fs/promises access, ENOENT), return 'invalid' with normalizeColorTheme errors, otherwise write a temp file in the themes dir and rename() it over the target (atomic) and return 'saved'. Add ROUTE_SHADOWED_IDS = ['selection'] and make claimThemeFile skip that candidate like a reserved id. Use fs/promises only. Add the five store tests named in PRD W1 to store.test.ts.
